programs.name: Summer Analyst and Summer Associate Programs

source.note: Firm's own intern and graduate recruitment page.

apply.note: Firm's own recruitment page; applications are submitted through the PWP portal linked from it.

process.quote: Telephone Screens: Selected candidates will be advanced to a telephone interview where we spend time getting to know you and your background, understanding your interest in Investment Banking and PWP. First Round Interviews: Candidates progressed will be invited to complete a one-hour interview, where we will explore your motivations and technical skill set in more detail. Assessment Days: At the final stage, candidates are invited to the Assessment Day and will complete verbal and numerical tests. The AD will consist of a mixture of interviews and a case study.

cooling_off.notes: The page carries no sentence addressing reapplication, waiting periods, or a cap on applications. Searched the fetched markup for 'reappl', 're-appl', 'apply again' and 'waiting period': no match.

unfiled_quotes.quote: We recruit for Advisory Full-Time hires in August, Summer Analysts in the winter, and Summer Associates in the fall across our New York, Houston, Chicago, Los Angeles and San Francisco offices.

provenance.note: class_year is silent deliberately: the page sets out the selection stages in detail but never states a year of study or graduation window. Searched for 'penultimate' and 'eligib': no match. What this record contributes is the firm's stated process, which is unusually explicit.
